requirements.title: MAXEXPONENT argument restriction
requirements.definition: X shall be real and may be scalar or array.

pending.MAXEXPONENT-X-real: Positive source controls call MAXEXPONENT with scalar and array real X values; source-control mutations use integer, complex, and logical X values and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MAXEXPONENT-X-scalar-or-array: Positive source controls call MAXEXPONENT with scalar, rank-one, and rank-two real X values; a source-control mutation using an unsupported non-real expression claims no diagnostic facet rather than a rank diagnostic.

requirements.title: MAXEXPONENT result is a default integer scalar
requirements.definition: The MAXEXPONENT result is a scalar of default integer type.

pending.MAXEXPONENT-result-default-integer: Assign MAXEXPONENT(1.0) to a default integer sentinel and assert KIND(MAXEXPONENT(1.0))==KIND(0); mutate the expected kind in the source-control check so the check fails.
pending.MAXEXPONENT-result-scalar: Call MAXEXPONENT on a rank-one real array and assert RANK of the result expression is zero via scalar assignment plus a non-array companion; mutate the companion to an array-valued inquiry so the scalar check fails.

requirements.title: MAXEXPONENT returns emax for the real model of X
requirements.definition: The MAXEXPONENT result has the value emax from 16.4 for the model representing numbers of the same type and kind as X.

pending.MAXEXPONENT-same-type-kind-model: Use scalar and rank-one real X values of the same kind, assert MAXEXPONENT values are equal, then use a guarded different real kind and assert the inquiry follows X kind rather than default real by comparing same-kind scalar and array calls.
pending.MAXEXPONENT-exact-emax-value: No portable exact numeric oracle: p5 names the 16.4 emax model parameter, but that model parameter is processor dependent and this intrinsic is the inquiry exposing it.
pending.MAXEXPONENT-HUGE-EXPONENT-relation: For default real and double precision real sentinels, assert the portable model relation EXPONENT(HUGE(x)) == MAXEXPONENT(x), derived from MAXEXPONENT emax in 16.9.136, HUGE model-number extremum in 16.9.96, EXPONENT in 16.9.85, and the 16.4 real model. Mutate HUGE(x) to x so the exponent relation fails.

accounting.rationale: Description names MAXEXPONENT as maximum exponent of a real model.
Classifies MAXEXPONENT as an inquiry function.
Result Value combines same-type/kind model selection with the exact emax value for that processor model.
The exact emax value is determined by the processor's 16.4 real model; p5 also has a separate same-type-and-kind model-selection obligation.
Example paragraph is illustrative and tied to a particular model.
